default.$description: Translucent neutral overlay — pure black on light surfaces (darkest greyscale). Default rests at 10% alpha; hover steps up to 20%; active/selected sit at 15%.

hover.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: black at 20% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

active.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: black at 15% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

selected.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: black at 15% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

hover.$description: FILL, not text: the outline button's hover fill, with --color-content-light drawn on it. Must clear 4.5:1 against that label.

active.$description: FILL, not text: the outline button's pressed fill, with --color-content-light drawn on it. Must clear 4.5:1 against that label.

default.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: fully transparent resting state, so the ghost button shows the surface beneath it.
OVERLAY, not a fill: near-black (#020202) at 2% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.
